subject: Onboarding tokens while PO processes - request
messages:
From: Caroline Liu <caroline.liu@nimblehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — onboarding tokens while PO processes

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at NimbleHealth is excited. Our procurement team is taking a bit longer than expected to issue the PO (internal approvals are staging), and I wanted to check whether Redwood can keep our onboarding environment live for a short while so we don’t lose momentum.

Specifically: can we get a small token grant or short extension (5–7 days) to keep the pilot active while the PO routes through Finance? We don’t want the engineers to lose access mid-sprint.

If helpful I can loop in procurement (I’ve cc’d them).

Appreciate any flexibility — we’re still planning to move forward.

Best,
Caroline Liu
Head of Integrations, NimbleHealth
caroline.liu@nimblehealth.com

Attachments: none
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Liu <caroline.liu@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — onboarding tokens while PO processes

Hi Caroline — thanks for the heads up and for looping procurement.

We can absolutely avoid an interruption. Two quick options to consider:

- Short voucher: 7-day token grant that keeps the existing sandbox and agent configs active. No product changes required.
- Micro-extension: 30% additional token buffer applied to your current pilot quota for 5 days.

I attached a quick SOW draft and our standard voucher terms so procurement has something concrete to review. If procurement needs it, we can send a simple amendment to keep access while their PO clears.

What would you prefer? If you want the voucher, I can issue it immediately and have Dev follow up with the code and a DocuSign link for acknowledgement.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: nimble_sow_draft.pdf (doc stub), voucher_terms.txt (text stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — onboarding tokens while PO processes

Vanessa — thanks for flagging. Approve a short safety net here but keep it conservative. Authorize a 5-day voucher (tokens sufficient for their current sprint) rather than a full 7-day open grant. Ask legal to note this as a grace access (no billing change).

Please:
- Issue the 5-day voucher today and record the change in HubSpot (link below).
- Make sure voucher terms are attached for procurement to sign.

Cc'ing Dev to handle issuance and tracking.

Marissa
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: none
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Liu <caroline.liu@nimblehealth.com>, procurement@nimblehealth.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Voucher issued: NimbleHealth — 5-day onboarding safety net (DEAL-5942)

Hi Caroline / Procurement team —

Per Vanessa and Marissa's sign-off, I have issued a 5-day voucher tied to DEAL-5942. The voucher activates immediately and will keep your onboarding environment live through 2026-06-21 08:00 PDT.

Attached is a CSV with the voucher code and a brief acknowledgement form. Please sign the short acknowledgement via DocuSign (link below) so we have procurement on record. If procurement prefers a short amendment instead, reply and we’ll generate it.

Voucher details:
- Voucher ID: NV-5942-5D
- Valid: 2026-06-16T08:00:00-07:00 through 2026-06-21T08:00:00-07:00
- Scope: Sandbox + 2 dedicated dev seats; token allowance matches current pilot usage

Attachments: nimble_voucher_codes.csv (contains voucher code stub)
Links: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/1234-5678
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/98765 (DEAL-5942)

Let me know if procurement needs any billing paperwork — happy to expedite.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
From: Caroline Liu <caroline.liu@nimblehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimblehealth.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Voucher issued: NimbleHealth — 5-day onboarding safety net (DEAL-5942)

Hi all —

Thanks so much, this is perfect. Procurement will complete the DocuSign acknowledgement this morning and we’ll confirm when the PO is on its way. The team will keep working through the sprint without interruption.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Caroline
